name: Ahmad bin Razali
bio: Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, attending local races with his father. He pursued a degree in communications, specializing in public relations, recognizing the crucial role PR plays in shaping a team's image. After graduating, Ahmad interned with a local touring car team, quickly proving his ability to craft compelling narratives and manage media relations effectively. He approaches his role with a data-driven mindset, analyzing trends and tailoring communication strategies to maximize impact. His knack for identifying emerging digital platforms and leveraging them for brand building sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly side-parted with a slight fade.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build, usually seen wearing smart-casual attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having his desk organized in a specific way, with everything in its place.
